title: RenewClaimRequest
description: Body of POST /tasks/{task_id}/claims/{claim_id}/renew. Sets expires_at = now + lease_seconds; may shorten the lease (CLAIM-023).

lease_seconds.description: Lease length in seconds. Default limits.claim_lease_default_seconds; outside [limits.claim_lease_min_seconds, limits.claim_lease_max_seconds] is 400 validation_failed, never clamped (CLAIM-020).
